summary.tldr: Changes the GST rebate for new rental housing and updates Competition Act rules on market inquiries and anti-competitive conduct.
what_it_does: Expands the GST New Residential Rental Property Rebate for qualifying purpose-built rental housing started after September 13, 2023, and completed before 2036.
Changes how the rebate is calculated for qualifying purpose-built rental housing, including rules for condominium units and other units.
Adjusts rebate rules for public service bodies so tax used in this rental-housing rebate is not counted again under section 259.
Creates a process for the Competition Commissioner or the minister to start an inquiry into competition in a market or industry, with public comment on draft terms of reference and a report deadline.
Adds excessive and unfair selling prices to the abuse-of-dominance rules, allows stronger Tribunal orders, and raises possible administrative monetary penalties.
Removes the efficiency-gains exceptions in sections 90.1 and 96, and lets the Tribunal act on some agreements even when the parties are not competitors.
summary.background: The bill amends the Excise Tax Act and the Competition Act.
